title: Austin Streets and City Hall Improvements Planned
summary:
• **Street Infrastructure Investment**: The city approved $300 for West 6th Street improvements and $425 for paving and water pipe work on the same street, plus $200 in general street labor funding and authorization for steam roller repairs.

• **New City Hall in the Works**: Council formed a special committee to develop plans for a new city hall building, signaling the city's growth and need for expanded municipal facilities.

• **Pound Ordinance Debate**: Citizens submitted conflicting petitions asking the council to both repeal and keep a recently-passed pound ordinance (for animal control), which was referred to the Police Committee for further consideration.

• **Property Tax Redemption**: An ordinance allowed property owners who lost land to tax sales to reclaim their property within 60 days under certain conditions.

• **Labor Relations Outreach**: Council formally invited the Texas State Federation of Labor to hold its next annual meeting in Austin, aiming to attract the event to the city.

Austin, Texas, April 17, 1905
Invitation to State Whereas, The Texas State Federation of Labor is soon to have
Federation of Labor its annual meeting in the City of Denison, Texas; And to hold annual
Whereas, there are distinguished delegates to the session in Austin State Federation of
Labor from the City of Austin, who the citizens of Austin believe will be able to Secure
for the City of Austin the next annual meeting of the State Federation of Labor; and
Whereas, the citizens and public officials of the City of Austin are desirous of having
the State Federation of Labor meet in the City of Austin at its next annual Meeting.
Therefore, be it resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin, that we issue to the
State Federation of Labor and to each and every one of the delegates thereof an invitation
to meet in the City of Austin at their next Annual Meeting, and that we extend to them, in
case they see fit to meet in the City of Austin, a most cordial welcome, and promise to
them a most hearty good time! And Be it further Resolved, that a copy of this resolution
be Given to the delegates from the City of Austin to the State Federation of Labor, and
